title: Audio device
description: A microphone, a line input or a sound card. Leave everything empty and the machine's default input runs at unity gain.

device.title: Input
device.description: Which input. The id from `list_audio_inputs`, the name the system shows, or a number counting from 0. Empty means the machine's first input, which is usually the one the operating system calls the default.

gain_db.title: Gain
gain_db.description: How much to lift or cut this input before it reaches the mix. 0 is unity, which is what the device sends. Changes apply while the source is live.

muted.title: Muted
muted.description: Silence this input without stopping it. The device stays open, so unmuting is instant.

label.title: Label
label.description: A name for this input, shown wherever the source is listed.

element.title: Capture element
element.description: Force one GStreamer capture element instead of letting the plugin choose. On Windows, `directsoundsrc` is the fallback for wasapi2src's stutter. Empty is the right answer almost always.
